non_completion_claim: The canonical split, full product adjudications, DDD dossiers, exact compiler maps and structural vertical remaps are complete; neither replacement product is ratified, no provider is qualified or portable and no vertical acceptance has been executed.
ruling: The existing Data Quality and Reconciliation candidate is an overloaded suite-shaped boundary. Data-quality operations and reconciliation/control operations have different sovereign questions, truth roles, aggregate lifecycles, authorities, users, vertical applicability and effect paths and must be adjudicated as separate product candidates.
